answer: Propose one AI vote/key/day for grading 1,000 fresh pearl images. Validators issue disjoint key-bound batches and check hidden reference grades; a batch-accuracy nadir below 90% denies the vote. Leaked tests, dishonest validators or cheap guessing can erase the cost. A bridge must use the validators' global spent-receipt ledger. Inference expense recurs; models/GPUs are reusable capital; no stake is locked. Sharing and parallel batching lower cost, not task count. At an assumed 1 GPU-ms/image after batching, ten keys need 10 x 1,000 x 1 ms = 10 GPU-s/day.
